name: jeebhar
description: Jeebhar — social media marketing site for restaurants and food brands (React + PHP, hosted on Bluehost)

scripts.release: npm run build:bluehost && npm run deploy:bluehost
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client run lint && npm run lint:api
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:client
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
